newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Taiwan's Victor Taichung sets US$40 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Victor Taichung sets US$40 mln FRN.

text.p: A US$40 million floating rate note issue for Victor-Taichung Investment Co Ltd BVI is in general syndication, bankers said Monday.
They said the deal is guaranteed by Victor Taichung Machinery Works Co. Ltd.
The facility has a final maturity of five years with a put option in years three and four.
The issue was priced at par to float at 80 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
There is a put-option waiver fee of 10 basis points.
With fees, the all-in return for lead managers is 90 basis points.

The deal is secured by financial covenants which state that the guarantor must have a maximum leverage ratio of 1.4, minimum interest coverage ratio of 2.25, minimum current ratio of 1.35 and minimum tangible net worth NT$3.4 billion.
